income.name: Income Name (English)
income.tax_calculation_type.warning: Not calculating tax for this income may result in errors in tax documentation such as P.N.D 1, P.N.D 1 Kor, Kor Tor 20 as well as the Section 50 Bis for employees later on. Please carefully consider any changes.
income.tax_calculation_type.tooltip:
Determine whether the income or deduction will be taxable or not.
In the case of All-year calculation, this amount will be automatically calculated as a regular income tax.
In the case of One-time calculation, suitable for the irregular income or deduction, this amount will be used for tax calculation only in the selected period.
income.income_value.label: Income value
income.income_value.warning: New value will automatically replace all previous entries
income.income_value.tooltip: With a fixed income which is applied for all employees, you can set up a specific amount here!
income.frequency_of_payment.tooltip:
In condition Every Period, this income will be paid in every period. (Suitable for cases in which there is more than 1 payment per month.)
In condition The Last Period of Month, this income will be paid in the last period of the month (E.g. If the payment is scheduled for 2 times per month, this addition will be paid in the 2nd time.)

deduction.frequency_of_payment.tooltip:
